scientific_issue: The Statement defined torsion-free but omitted requiring it, while proof1.1 assumed torsion-free stalks.
counterexample: Choose two reduced affine points Z and an affine point p, all disjoint from L_infinity. E=I_Z direct-sum C_p has generic rank N=1 and chi(E(m))=binom(m+2,2)-2+1=binom(m+2,2)-1, so k=1. It has the required trivial framing near infinity, but the skyscraper summand gives nonzero H0(E(-1)). Thus framing and Hilbert polynomial do not imply torsion-freeness.
